points.text: Headline gains computed at favourable budgets; selection of 58.4% figure unstated
SeerAttn-R comparison not matched in training data/compute; setup and budget semantics unclear
Missing learned-eviction baselines (Locret, NACL) or simple trained gate ablation
SnapKV/H2O run in prefill-compression setting may not be intended use
No confidence intervals; 'surpasses full cache' claims rest on single runs
Low full-cache scores suggest truncation; regularisation explanation untested; generation lengths unreported
Training soft logit modulation vs inference hard eviction mismatch unanalysed
Multiplicative logit decay parameterisation unjustified; up-weights negative q·k
Capacity loss M=512 vs wide inference budgets; sensitivity only in appendix
Query-independent retention cannot capture future-query dependence; SCBench retrieval failures unanalysed
'Consistently outperforms' overstated; LongBenchV2 only in appendix
Interpretability claims rest on hand-picked heads without quantitative or causal validation
Efficiency evidence thin: single setup, no memory or gate overhead
Budget uniform across heads; heterogeneous allocation benefits not realised
Gates trained per model and domain; retraining cost unacknowledged
Limited to 14B/128K; quantisation and multi-turn prefix caching not discussed
'Globally optimal caching policy' claim unsupported
Typos, reliance on appendix, gains hard to verify from figures
Why not fold into normal model training; integration path not addressed
Interaction of learned decay with positional encoding unclear; may be recency bias
Fixed memory budget; adaptive per-layer/head/task budgets unexplored
Missing comparison with Locret
No evaluation on RULER and LongBench-V2
Exponential decay aggressive; may degenerate into sliding window
Query-agnostic baselines InfiniPot and Locret not discussed or compared
General long-context benchmarks (RULER, LongBench) missing; retrieval weakness undiscussed
Training setup and training cost unclear
Unclear whether multi-turn conversation supported
Writing: long Appendix C, uninformative Figure 4, conclusion uses model output
